name: moodle-obsidian
description: Your Moodle courses, grades, deadlines and forums in Claude, synced into an Obsidian vault. Works with SSO universities.

vault_dir.title: Obsidian vault
vault_dir.description: Folder of your Obsidian vault. Notes, the deadline calendar and course materials are written here, and nowhere else.

moodle_url.title: Moodle URL (optional)
moodle_url.description: Your Moodle's https address. Leave empty if you log in with `moodle-mcp --login` (recommended).

moodle_token.title: Moodle token (optional)
moodle_token.description: Mobile web service token. Leave empty if you log in with `moodle-mcp --login` (recommended).
